newsitem.title: USA: LITTON,TRACOR UNITS GET US CONTRACTS.
newsitem.headline: LITTON,TRACOR UNITS GET US CONTRACTS.

text.p: The Department of Defense said Friday that it awarded three contracts totalling $1.56 billion for firms to buy support hardware and automation-related products for the Army's Military Health Service System.
Defense said it awarded $693.4 million to PRC Inc of Reston, Va, a subsidiary of Litton Industries Inc..
A contract for $375.2 million went to Cordant Inc of Reston Va, a subsidiary of Tracor Inc, it said.
And an award of $488.4 million was given to SAIC Inc of San Diego, Calif., it said.
All three are fixed-price, indefinite delivery/indefinite quantity contracts.
All contract work is set for completion August 4, 1999, the department said.
